name: Anuv Gupta
title: Anuv's Projects
tagline:
I keep some projects here.
Thanks for visiting!
description: Projects by Anuv Gupta, engineer and artist.

projects.name: SkyTube: Watch videos while playing Skyrim
projects.description: SKSE plugin for Skyrim and Enderal SE that plays YouTube videos, livestreams or video files in a picture-in-picture window while you play. It pauses during conversations and remembers where each video left off.

projects.name: Anuv's Projects
projects.description: This site: a Windows XP-style desktop built with Astro, with draggable windows, a Start menu and a live, procedurally drawn wallpaper. All content comes from one validated JSON manifest.

projects.name: Murk3D
projects.description: A browser-based high-fantasy open-world RPG built with Three.js: first-person exploration of hills ringed by mountains, with a full day-night cycle.

projects.name: Pilo Voice Assistant
projects.description: A local-first voice assistant on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a four-mic array: say the wake word, ask a question, and it answers out loud. Speech-to-text, the LLM and text-to-speech can each run on the Pi, a stronger machine on the LAN, or in the cloud.

projects.name: apple-notes-sync
projects.description: Keeps a folder of Markdown files in sync with Apple Notes every 15 seconds, so Obsidian, grep or Basic Memory's semantic search can read your notes. Plain system Python, run as a macOS background agent.

projects.name: PiWii
projects.description: Turns a Raspberry Pi into a network-fed USB drive for a softmodded Wii. A Wii Menu-style web app converts and uploads games, and the Pi copies them onto the drive whenever the Wii goes idle.

projects.name: turnstile-solver
projects.description: A fork of a multi-threaded Cloudflare Turnstile solver API, adding Camoufox support, a Docker Compose setup, a page-readiness wait option and a /health endpoint for automatic recovery.

projects.name: git-autosync
projects.description: Auto-commits, rebases and pushes any git repo on a schedule, each repo with its own scheduler and lock. Works on macOS, Linux (cron or systemd) and Windows.

projects.name: Projector Screen Controller
projects.description: An ESPHome controller for a motorized projector screen. A Home Assistant automation lowers it whenever the NVIDIA Shield is on or the projector's smart plug shows it drawing power, and raises it once both are off.

projects.name: Presence-Based LED Light Strips
projects.description: Hallway LED strips that follow you as you walk: LD2450 mmWave radar sensors publish targets over MQTT, a fusion service tracks each person along the hallway, and WLED strips light up where they are. Occupancy shows up in Home Assistant.

projects.name: Sound Design AI: Talk to Your Synthesizer
projects.description: A fork of the open-source Vital wavetable synth that adds an AI agent side panel inside the synth, backed by its own cloud infrastructure.

projects.name: CityScape
projects.description: A procedurally generated 3D city in a single HTML file with Three.js: instanced buildings, sunlight and shadows, and wind-blown grass, tuned to run smoothly in iPad Safari.

projects.name: Sketchy: Image Gen Sketchpad
projects.description: A website for generating images with Stable Diffusion: a ComfyUI worker on RunPod's serverless GPUs, AWS infrastructure in CDK, and a simple web frontend.

projects.name: b
projects.description: A tiny Node CLI that runs named build targets from a project's b.json, like a lightweight Make. Used across my web and infrastructure repos.

projects.name: Edge AI: Computer Vision Competition
projects.description: Compressed MobileNet into a 30 KB network that predicts in about 1 ms with over 70% accuracy on CIFAR-10. Won 1st in the speed competition for UT's EE379K Edge AI course.

projects.name: Rubbr.io
projects.description: A multiplayer .io-style car arena with socket.io and HTML5 canvas: crash cars, collect cash and race to the top of the leaderboard.

screenshots.alt: rubbr gameplay: a car among cash pickups

projects.name: block.js
projects.description: A JavaScript library for building web UIs from modular, event-driven templates, without writing HTML.
